texts.name: Farmer Nicolai
texts.biography: Nicolai remembers the time before the thaw. Raging cold and biting frost were the daily reality for the Vori—conditions he never managed to get used to. That is why, as soon as the Sword of Frost was taken away and spring arrived, he was the happiest man alive. He quickly settled into the role of a farmer, and cultivating potatoes became his greatest passion.

specialty.name: Potatoes
specialty.description: Increases Speed of any Potatoes or Noble potatoes by 1 and their Attack and Defense skills by 5% for every 7 levels (rounded up).
